name: ButtonGroup
description: A button group shows related action buttons together, evenly spaced, in a row or a column. It holds actions only; to pick one of a few options or views, use Tabs with the segmented appearance.
whenToUse: For two to five related actions, e.g. Previous / Next or Bold / Italic / Underline.

whenNotToUse.text: To switch between panels of content.
To pick one of a few options or views, e.g. Day / Week / Month.
To pick a value for a form.

anatomy.name: Buttons
anatomy.description: Regular Buttons, each with its own action.

states.name: Button states
states.meaning: Hover, focus and disabled come from Button.

behavior.text: Every button is a Tab stop and shows its own focus ring.

content: Use short, parallel labels, or icons with aria-labels (IconButton).

guidelines.dont: Put Save and Delete in one group.
guidelines.why: A destructive action needs to stand apart from safe ones.

guidelines.dont: Leave a group of icon buttons unnamed.
guidelines.why: The name tells screen reader users what the buttons control.

guidelines.do: Use segmented Tabs to pick one of a few options.
guidelines.dont: Use a button group as a selector.
guidelines.why: Tabs expose the selection and support arrow-key navigation.

accessibility.focus: Each button shows its focus ring.

examples.title: Spaced
examples.code:
import { ButtonGroup, Button } from '@ds/react';

<ButtonGroup aria-label="Pages">
  <Button appearance="outline" variant="secondary">Previous</Button>
  <Button appearance="outline" variant="secondary">Next</Button>
</ButtonGroup>

examples.title: Vertical
examples.description: Stacked full width, e.g. in a narrow panel.
examples.code:
import { ButtonGroup, Button } from '@ds/react';

<ButtonGroup aria-label="Export" orientation="vertical">
  <Button appearance="outline" variant="secondary">Export as CSV</Button>
  <Button appearance="outline" variant="secondary">Export as PDF</Button>
</ButtonGroup>

examples.title: Icon buttons
examples.description: A toolbar of related icon actions, each named with a label.
examples.code:
import { ButtonGroup, IconButton } from '@ds/react';
import { Bold, Italic, Underline } from 'lucide-react';

<ButtonGroup aria-label="Text style">
  <IconButton icon={<Bold />} label="Bold" variant="secondary" appearance="outline" />
  <IconButton icon={<Italic />} label="Italic" variant="secondary" appearance="outline" />
  <IconButton icon={<Underline />} label="Underline" variant="secondary" appearance="outline" />
</ButtonGroup>

related.relation: For switching content panels, and (segmented) for picking one option.

changes: Breaking: segmented selection (value, defaultValue, onValueChange) removed. Use Tabs with appearance="segmented".
Breaking: the attached layout is removed; buttons are always spaced (--button-group-border-width token removed).

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.description:
Related action buttons shown together, spaced apart. To pick one of a few options or
views, use Tabs with the segmented appearance instead.

aria-label.description: Names the group for screen readers, e.g. "Text alignment".
